Class Host

java.lang.Object
entity.Staff
entity.Host
public class Host extends Staff
The Host (Stage 3): seats at most one queued customer per turn, in addition to the Waiter's task. The Waiter can still seat customers too.

Like the Waiter, the Host extends Staff, so the one-action-per-turn rule comes from there. The seating itself goes through Restaurant.seat(Customer, Table), the same method the Waiter uses, so the seating rules are written once.

      Seats a queued customer at a free table.
      Parameters:
      restaurant - the restaurant that owns the queue and the tables
      customer - the queued customer to seat
      table - the table to seat them at
      Throws:
